Challenges

Sound familiar?

“We installed an SEO plugin and rankings never moved.”

A plugin is a toolbox, not a strategy. Configuration — schemas, sitemaps, breadcrumbs, indexing rules — is where the value is, and it is usually left at defaults.

“Google indexes hundreds of tag and archive pages.”

WordPress generates duplicates by default. The indexation cleanup decides what deserves indexing and shuts the rest down cleanly.

“Our site got slower with every plugin we added.”

Plugin bloat is the top WordPress speed killer. The stack audit keeps the plugins that earn their weight and replaces or removes the rest.

“A theme update broke our titles and schema.”

Configuration is documented in a record your team keeps, so updates stop silently undoing SEO work.

“We were hacked and our rankings tanked.”

Compromised sites get flagged and dropped. We coordinate the cleanup, the security hardening and the recovery requests in the right order.

“WooCommerce products barely rank.”

Woo stores inherit every WordPress issue plus product schema and faceted-navigation problems — all covered in the audit.

“Our developer and our SEO give opposite advice.”

We work the whole stack — hosting, theme, plugins, content — so recommendations arrive as one coherent, implementable list.

“Nobody monitors the site’s SEO health.”

Monthly health monitoring watches indexation, speed and errors, so small breakages get fixed before they cost rankings.

How It Works

WordPress gives you control — if someone sets it up right

WordPress powers a huge share of the web, and most installations leak SEO value in the same places: bloated plugins, tag and archive duplicates, slow themes, and SEO plugins left on default settings.

We audit the whole stack — hosting, theme, plugins, content structure — then configure, clean and optimise it into a fast, well-structured site that search engines can crawl and rank confidently.

  • WordPress SEO audit
  • Plugin configuration record
  • Indexation cleanup report
  • Speed optimisation report
  • Schema implementation
  • Monthly health monitoring

FAQs

FAQs on WordPress SEO services

Which SEO plugin do you use?

Rank Math or Yoast — whichever fits your setup; the configuration matters more than the brand.

Can you fix a hacked site's rankings?

Yes — cleanup verification plus an SEO recovery plan; see also our penalty recovery service.

Do you need admin access?

Yes, with your own user account — we document every change we make.

Will updates break the SEO setup?

Our monitoring catches regressions after updates, and changes are logged so anything can be rolled back.

Do you also fix the issues, or only report them?

Both paths exist: we can implement the configuration sprint directly, or hand your developer a documented, prioritised fix list and verify the work.

Will configuration changes break our site?

Changes are staged, backed up and tested — and the configuration record means anything can be rolled back precisely.
